app.name: Bazaart AI Photo Editor Design
app.description: An AI-powered photo and video editing app for designing graphics, removing backgrounds, and creating collages.

verdict.one_liner: Bazaart shares your data with numerous third-party tracking and AI services, and your photos may be processed on external servers, but you can use the app without signing up and request data deletion.
verdict.summary: Bazaart is a popular AI photo and video editor that allows use without mandatory signup. It deletes server copies of processed content after a few days and does not retain face detection data. However, it shares personal information with many third-party analytics and tracking services, sends your photos and videos to external AI providers for processing, uses your contact information for promotional emails, and claims a broad license to use your name and likeness for publicity.
verdict.recommendation_reason: While Bazaart offers useful creative tools and allows anonymous use, the extensive data sharing with tracking and AI services, combined with promotional marketing and broad content licenses, creates meaningful privacy risks. Consider whether you are comfortable with your photos being processed by multiple external AI services and your activity being tracked by numerous analytics providers.

red.title: Data shared with many tracking and analytics companies
red.plain_english: Bazaart shares your information with more than ten third-party services including Facebook, AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Hotjar, Amplitude, and Firebase for analytics, tracking, and notifications.

red.title: Photos and videos sent to external AI services
red.plain_english: Your photos and videos are processed on Bazaart's servers and may also be sent to external AI services including OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Replicate for editing and generation features.

red.title: Personal information used for promotional offers
red.plain_english: Bazaart uses your email address and phone number to send you promotional offers and newsletters, and may contact you about surveys.

red.title: Broad license to use your likeness for promotion
red.plain_english: By using Bazaart, you give them permission to use your name, image, and likeness to promote content you create on the platform.

red.title: Multiple tracking and analytics tools installed
red.plain_english: The app includes several analytics and tracking services such as Facebook, AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Firebase, and Hotjar that monitor how you use the app.

green.title: No mandatory signup required
green.plain_english: You can use Bazaart without creating an account. Signing up is only required if you want to use the app on multiple devices or subscribe to premium features.

green.title: Server copies of content deleted after a few days
green.plain_english: Photos and videos processed on Bazaart's servers are deleted periodically after a short period of time, usually a few days.

green.title: Users can request deletion of their information
green.plain_english: You can review your information in the app and request to delete all relevant information.

green.title: Face detection data is not saved
green.plain_english: Bazaart uses Apple's built-in Vision Framework on your device to detect faces in photos, but they do not retain any face data from this process.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Bazaart needs your camera and microphone to take photos and record videos for editing. Your photos and videos are sent to their servers for processing and kept for a few days.
categories.detail: The app requests camera permission for taking photos and videos, and microphone and speech recognition permissions to transcribe videos. Photos and videos processed through server-side services are retained for a limited time, usually a few days.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may require additional device permissions to provide you certain parts of the services. These include camera permission for taking photos and videos, microphone and speech recognition permissions to transcribe videos, and storage permissions to access files on your device for processing.
concerns: Photos and videos processed on external servers
Server-side copies retained for a few days

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not say whether Bazaart collects or uses your location.
categories.detail: The policy does not explicitly mention GPS location tracking or location-based services.
concerns: Policy is silent on location access

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Bazaart does not ask for access to your contacts list.
categories.detail: The privacy policy and terms of service do not mention accessing or uploading contacts from your device.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Bazaart asks for storage permission so you can import photos and videos from your device to edit them.
categories.detail: The app requests storage permissions to access files on your device for processing. This is required for the core photo and video editing functionality.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may require additional device permissions to provide you certain parts of the services... and storage permissions to access files on your device for processing.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Bazaart shares your information with many third-party companies, including analytics trackers like Facebook and AppsFlyer, and sends your photos and videos to external AI services like OpenAI and Google for processing.
categories.detail: The policy lists over ten third-party services with access to personal data, including Apple Analytics, Facebook, AppsFlyer, Amplitude, OneSignal, Google Payments, Google Analytics, Firebase, Hotjar Analytics, and Sentry.io. Additionally, user content may be processed by external AI and media services including Unsplash, Noun Project, Pexels, Replicate Inc., Soundstripe, Google Gemini, Cloud Vertex AI Imagen, and OpenAI ChatGPT/GPT Image.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use the following third party services: (i) Apple Analytics; (ii) Facebook; (iii) AppsFlyer; (iv) Amplitude; (v) OneSignal; (vi) Google Payments; (vii) Google Analytics; (viii) Firebase; (ix) Hotjar Analytics; (x) Sentry.io.
concerns: Extensive list of third-party analytics and tracking services
User photos and videos sent to multiple external AI processing services
Email shared with Amplitude for analytics

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: You can use Bazaart without creating an account, but if you sign up, they collect your name, photo, and email. They share your email with analytics and payment companies, and they can use your name and photos to promote content you create.
categories.detail: Sign-up is optional and can be done via Google, Meta, or Apple. Registered users provide name, photo, and email address. Email is shared with Amplitude (analytics) and Paddle (payments). The terms include a broad publicity license allowing Bazaart to use the user's name, image, and likeness to promote posted content.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may use your email address with third party services, including Amplitude for analytics and Paddle for payments. You hereby grant us permission to use your name, image, information and likeness in relation to the content you posted.
concerns: Broad publicity license for user content

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Bazaart uses multiple tracking services including Facebook, Google Analytics, and AppsFlyer to monitor how you use the app. They also send promotional emails and newsletters using your personal information.
categories.detail: The app integrates numerous analytics and tracking services including Facebook, AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Firebase, Hotjar Analytics, and Sentry.io. The policy explicitly states that personal information including email and phone numbers may be used for promotional offers and newsletters.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may use the information you provided us, including your email address and phone numbers to provide you with promotional offers and newsletters.
concerns: Personal contact information used for promotional marketing

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Bazaart says you must be at least 13 years old to use the app, and if you are between 13 and 18 you need a parent's permission. The app is a photo editor that may appeal to younger teens.
categories.detail: The terms require users to be over 18 or over 13 with legal guardian consent. There is no explicit enforcement mechanism mentioned, and photo editing apps are commonly used by teenagers.
categories.policy_excerpt: you are either over 18 years of age, or if you're over 13 and under 18, you obtained your legal guardian's consent to these terms
concerns: Photo editing app likely appeals to teens
No strong age verification mechanism described

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Bazaart collects your IP address and other technical information about your device and internet connection.
categories.detail: The policy states that technical information about the device is collected, including IP address and operating system. This is standard technical logging.
categories.policy_excerpt: We collect some raw information which may be considered as personally identifiable, which is technical information about your device, such as your IP address, your operating system and other technical information.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Bazaart collects technical details about your device like your IP address and operating system, and uses several analytics services that may track your device.
categories.detail: The policy collects IP address, operating system, and other technical information. Multiple analytics services (Google Analytics, Firebase, Hotjar, Sentry, AppsFlyer) are used, which typically collect device-level identifiers.
categories.policy_excerpt: technical information about your device, such as your IP address, your operating system and other technical information
concerns: Multiple analytics services with potential device tracking
IP address and technical data collected continuously

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Bazaart uses Apple's built-in face detection tool on your device to check if photos contain faces, but they do not save or keep any face data.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states that Apple's Vision Framework is used on-device to detect whether photos contain a person's face, and that face data is not retained.
categories.policy_excerpt: We use Apple's Vision Framework on iOS to inspect whether photos contain a person's face or not. However, in such use, your face data is not retained if the photo is found to include face data.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Payments are handled by Apple, Google, or Paddle. Bazaart does not directly store your payment card information.
categories.detail: Payments are processed through Apple or Google accounts, or independently via Paddle. The app does not appear to store raw payment card details directly.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may charge our fees through your Apple or Google account or independently; Google and Apple may offer refunds solely according to their policies. We use Paddle to process payments.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request to delete your information, and server copies of your photos are deleted after a few days. However, if you use their cloud backup service, your designs may be kept longer.
categories.detail: Users can review information in the app and request deletion of all relevant information. Server-side data is deleted periodically after a short time, usually a few days. However, designs are retained if the user uses cloud backup services.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can always review your information using our software and panel. You can also request to delete all relevant information. Server Side Data is deleted periodically after a short period of time, which is usually a few days. While we do not consider your designs and works as Personal Data, we do retain it if you use any of our cloud services.
concerns: Cloud backup designs retained even if other data deleted

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Bazaart will tell you about policy changes through electronic messages, and you can stop using the service with 30 days notice if you do not agree.
categories.detail: The terms state that amendments will be communicated electronically, and users are granted the option to terminate agreements with 30 days prior written notice.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may amend these terms from time to time, provided that you shall be informed through electronic communication on such amendment and shall be granted the option to terminate your agreements with us by providing a 30 days prior written notice.
